客.story: Under my **roof** (宀), **each** (各) person who walks through the door is treated as a **guest**.

師.story: A **slash** (丿) and a **line** (丨) hang beside a draped **cloth** (巾): the long robe of a wise **teacher**.

易.story: On a sunny **day** (日), nothing is forbidden (勿 **must not**), and every task you try feels **easy**.

迎.story: You **walk** (⻌) out with your head held **high** (卬) to **welcome** the guests at the gate.
